QuestInfo.name: Quill You Find My Pen
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2140000##k front of the Three Doors wants to talk to you...
QuestInfo.1: Find the Temple Keeper's lost #bQuill Pen#k. Go around the Temple of Time and search near the walls where the sculpture of the goddess is engraved.
QuestInfo.2: You found the Temple Keeper's Quill Pen in an ornate chest. There were other goodies inside as well. What is this mysterious chest?

0.0: May the goddess's blessings be with you. Would you have time to help me, now that you can go into the temple?
0.1: Last time I was in the temple, I lost my Quill Pen and now I can't manage my books. Do you think you could find it for me? I really like that pen.

yes.0: I just can't remember where I placed it! Look around the Temple of Time for an #eOrnate Chest#n. I bet the #bQuill Pen#k is inside. You should be able to find one if you look near the walls with goddess statue engravings.

no.0: I guess it's a bit of a pain. Maybe I can find a pencil.

1.0: Finally! My pen. My wonderful little pen!

item.0: Please look around the walls where the goddess statue is engraved very carefully.
